macros.name: forgitcommit
macros.doc: For displaying multiple commits the \forgitcommit is used, which has the same arguments as \gitcommit, but only this time the csname is executed for every commit.

macros.name: gitunsetdirectory
macros.doc: To undo an operation done with \gitdirectory and switch back to the main file’s directory, use \gitunsetdirectory.

macros.name: gitversion
macros.doc: The current version can be display by using \gitversion and is equivalent to git describe --tags --always, working for both lightweight and annotated tags.
